name: Spawnbroker — counters on Permanent A before the trigger is fired raise B's bound
notes: Spawnbroker's B is bounded by A's power as the trigger was fired (resolution-moment model: counters go on before firing). Hill Giant with three +1/+1 counters is 6/6 at fire time, so Craw Wurm (6) is a legal B and the two change controllers.
